# Glossary review: Chinese (Simplified) (`zh`)

*Written by `python scripts/intake/glossary_tool.py record`; `check` compares it with a fresh run. Do not edit it.*

Glossary version `1.0.0-draft`. These are DRAFTS until you approve them.

## What to check

1. Is the canonical form the word a trader of this language really uses for the term?
2. Are the other accepted spellings words a trader would also type (a short form, a plural, a verb form)? A question that contains any of them is recognised as containing the term.
3. Does any spelling also mean something else in this language? It would mark an unrelated question.
4. Do the texts below read naturally, say what the English says, and keep each `{name}` placeholder?

| Key | English | Chinese (Simplified) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| intake.refusal.not_signed_in | Please sign in to ask the AI analyst. | 请先登录，再向 AI 分析师提问。 |
| intake.refusal.tier_required | The AI analyst is part of the Pro plan. | AI 分析师属于 Pro 套餐。 |
| intake.refusal.thread_invalid | This conversation is not available. Start a new one about gold (XAUUSD). | 此对话不可用。请就黄金（XAUUSD）开始新的对话。 |
| intake.refusal.profile_not_set | Confirm your trading profile first. | 请先确认您的交易档案。 |
| intake.refusal.quota_insufficient | Your AI analyst allowance is used up for now. Please try again later. | 您的 AI 分析师使用额度暂时已用完。请稍后再试。 |
| intake.refusal.feature_unavailable | The AI analyst is not available yet. | AI 分析师暂未开放。 |
| intake.refusal.question_empty | Type a question about gold (XAUUSD) first. | 请先输入一个关于黄金（XAUUSD）的问题。 |
| intake.refusal.question_too_long | Your question is too long. Please keep it to {limit} characters or fewer. | 您的问题太长。请控制在 {limit} 个字符以内。 |
| intake.refusal.understanding_failed | That question could not be read just now. Please try again. | 暂时无法读取这个问题。请重试。 |
| intake.refusal.out_of_scope | This analyst covers gold (XAUUSD) on the M5 and M15 charts only. Ask about those. | 此分析师仅涵盖 M5 和 M15 图表上的黄金（XAUUSD）。请就这些提问。 |
| intake.instant.m5 | Explain the current M5 chart | 请解释当前的 M5 图表 |
| intake.instant.m15 | Explain the current M15 chart | 请解释当前的 M15 图表 |
| intake.reason.data_stale | The market data is out of date, so this sensor has no usable reading. | 市场数据已过期，因此该传感器没有可用的读数。 |
| intake.reason.retuning | The chart indicator is being re-tuned, so this reading is less reliable for now. | 图表指标正在重新校准，因此该读数暂时不太可靠。 |
| intake.reason.no_setting | No indicator setting is available for this timeframe, so this sensor cannot read it. | 该时间周期没有指标设置，因此该传感器无法读取。 |
| intake.reason.detection_mismatch | The indicator found in the data does not match its setting, so treat this reading with caution. | 数据中发现的指标与其设置不一致，请谨慎对待该读数。 |
| intake.reason.no_stats_at_slot | The statistics for this moment are not available yet, so this reading is out of date. | 此刻的统计数据尚不可用，因此该读数已过期。 |
| intake.reason.containment_low | The price is not staying inside the channel well enough for a reliable reading. | 价格没有足够地保持在通道内，无法得到可靠的读数。 |
| intake.reason.insufficient_bars | There are not enough closed bars yet for a reliable reading. | 已收盘的K线还不够，无法得到可靠的读数。 |
| intake.reason.discontinuity | The bars have gaps or are out of order, so this reading cannot be trusted. | K线存在缺口或顺序混乱，因此无法信任该读数。 |
| intake.reason.sanity_failed | The channel values are impossible, so this reading cannot be trusted. | 通道数值不合常理，因此无法信任该读数。 |
| intake.reason.upstream_cautionary | {sensor} is cautionary, so this reading is cautionary too. | {sensor} 处于谨慎状态，因此该读数也需谨慎对待。 |
| intake.reason.upstream_unavailable | {sensor} has no valid reading, so this one is unavailable. | {sensor} 没有有效读数，因此该读数不可用。 |
| intake.reason.upstream_stale | {sensor} is out of date, so this one is too. | {sensor} 已过期，因此该读数也已过期。 |
| intake.reason.mcd0_defect_m5 | The M5 channel does not fit the price well enough, so readings that use it are cautionary. | M5 通道与价格的拟合不够好，因此使用它的读数需谨慎对待。 |
| intake.reason.mcd0_defect_m15 | The M15 channel does not fit the price well enough, so readings that use it are cautionary. | M15 通道与价格的拟合不够好，因此使用它的读数需谨慎对待。 |
| intake.reason.evaluator_error | This sensor hit an unexpected error and has no reading right now. | 该传感器发生意外错误，目前没有读数。 |
| intake.reason.modifier_caution | Another sensor adds caution to this reading: {state}. | 另一个传感器为该读数增加了谨慎提示：{state} |

## Sign-off

Read the tables above, then edit `approval.json` in this folder: set `status` to `APPROVED`, `approved_by` to your name and `approved_on` to the date (YYYY-MM-DD). It holds the SHA-256 of the content you read, so a later change to it puts this area back to PENDING (`python scripts/intake/glossary_tool.py record`). Then run `record` once more so the forms of Chinese (Simplified) are marked `approved` in the glossary.
